messages:
Ryan Patel: Quick check — ZenHealth POC scheduled for next Wed. Customer needs SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC scopes per clinic, and confirmation on Dedicated pricing vs hosted. Also need our security questionnaire answered (HIPAA scope). Who can own technical pre-POC?

Alex Chen: I can run the presales tech call. Ryan, do you have IdP metadata and example user counts? Also need domain proofing details for domain claims.

Ryan Patel: We'll have Okta as IdP. ~2k active accounts, but POC will use 8 clinic admin accounts + 40 clinicians. Domain is zenhealth.com, they want org-level isolation.

Maria Gomez: For POC I recommend Hosted first with a dedicated model pin (fastest), but if HIPAA + org isolation required we should propose Redwood Private (VPC). For SCIM we support group-based provisioning and attribute mappings. Example SCIM patch we typically ask for:

```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"members","value": [{"value":"user-123"}]}]
}
```

Also SAML attrs we need: email, firstName, lastName, groups.

Jamal Khan: Security checklist highlights: SOC2 Type II, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS support (BYOK/HSM), audit logs for provision/deprovision, SCIM provisioning logs, SAML assertion lifetime, user deprovision SLO. For HIPAA we need BA and data residency — confirm whether PHI will be sent.

Ryan Patel: Yes, some PHI will be processed during workflows. BA needed.

Emily Ross: From commercial side — I'll prepare a Dedicated vs Private pricing sketch. For POC we can offer a short-term pilot discount. Need to know expected token/throughput during POC.

Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Ryan to send IdP metadata + example SCIM group mappings by EOD. 2) Maria to draft POC runbook + minimal infra options (hosted pinned vs private). 3) Jamal to fill HIPAA-specific questionnaire sections and confirm BA template. 4) Emily to send pricing ranges and pilot terms.

sec-bot: (uploaded) zenhealth-sso-questionnaire.xlsx

Ryan Patel: Uploaded metadata in email to alex@redwood.ai. I'll sync with security and send the questionnaire answers by tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Great — I'll schedule 30m pre-POC tech sync for Monday. Invite in #calendar.

Maria Gomez: One note — for RBAC, is per-clinic isolation logical or do they want cross-clinic admin? If per-clinic, we'll map groups -> tenant_id. Example SAML group claim: `clinic-admin:clinic-42`.

Ryan Patel: Per-clinic isolation. We'll provide group names.

Alex Chen: Ok, copying next steps to the thread and closing for now. If anything else pops up ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
